title: Simple Math Tester
shortDescription: Friendly math practice for kids: add, subtract, multiply and divide.
fullDescription:
Simple Math Tester is a friendly arithmetic workbook for children who are starting school math.

Practise addition, subtraction, multiplication and division, alone or mixed. Each kind of exercise has five difficulty levels. Start at Easy, Medium, Hard or Harder, and the app adapts to how well you answer.

Two more kinds can be switched on, also with five levels each: algebra, with equations that have one missing number, and geometry, with the perimeter, area, missing sides and angles of shapes drawn to scale.

- Big, clear numbers and an on-screen number pad.
- A wrong answer can be retried or skipped, and worked steps show how to solve it.
- "My answers" lets you review what you practised.
- Combos, experience points, player levels, a daily goal and a daily streak reward real progress.
- Relaxed practice has no timer. When you want speed, try the 60-second sprint.
- Sound and vibration can be switched off.

Private by design: no accounts, no ads, no tracking and no personal data collection. Progress is saved only on your device, and the app works fully offline.
